item.title: Diabetes risk rises early for South Asians in US despite healthy lifestyle, researchers warn
item.description: South Asians in the US face a higher diabetes risk by midlife despite healthier lifestyles. A study reveals nearly one in three South Asian men had prediabetes by age 45, highlighting a need for early screening and culturally tailored interventions.

item.title: Trump’s plan to wipe out US climate rules relies on EPA rescinding its 2009 endangerment finding — but will it survive court challenges?
item.description: The Trump administration aims to rescind the EPA's 2009 endangerment finding, potentially rolling back climate regulations. Legal challenges are expected, as scientific evidence of climate harm is stronger now than ever.

item.title: How Indigenous ideas about non-linear time can help us navigate ecological crises
item.description: Indigenous views on non-linear time, like those of the Māori, offer a holistic approach to ecological crises. By seeing time as spiraling, we can better connect past, present, and future, fostering a deeper bond with all life forms and encouraging sustainable solutions.
